Class Agent

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.agents.Agent
public class Agent extends Object
Represents a "Special Actor" or "Unit" in the simulation.

Unlike population densities (handled by H3SimulationEngine), these Agents represent specific, tracked individuals or groups with unique identity and state. Examples: Diplomats, Armies, Traders, Heroes.

They move across the H3 grid and interact with the density layer.
